client_identity.storage: runtime-injected secret; never persist token bytes in source, evidence, results, logs, or certification artifacts

prohibited_permissions: installation access to any repository other than OscarMackJr/bluto

runtime_binding.launcher: A dedicated AA4 launcher may obtain one installation token only after a fresh one-run authorization validates the exact target and unexpired window.
runtime_binding.transport: HTTPS GET only to the published D5 endpoint templates; reject redirect, non-200 response, endpoint expansion outside the contract, or any non-GET method.
runtime_binding.audit: Record client identity class and token issuance time only; never record a token or authorization header.

if_approved: authorizes GitHub App creation/installation and static client-binding implementation
authorizes a corrected readiness reconciliation after read-only access is verified
not_authorized: token issuance outside a fresh run window

review_instructions: James: approve only if the GitHub App is limited to Bluto and the stated read-only permissions. Approval does not configure the App, issue a token, or run AA4.
